Title: VTES Lords of the Night to Release September 26th

Messages.Author: atomweaver
Messages.Body:
from;

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=news&articleid=819

VTES Lords of the Night to Release September 26th
White Wolf Announces Vampire: The Eternal Struggle Lords of the Night
Launch Event

Now in its 13th year of play, White Wolf celebrates the latest expansion
of Vampire: The Eternal Struggle (VTES). White Wolf and the Princes of
the Elder Kindred Network (VEKN) are promoting a weekend long series of
tournaments and special events across the globe. Below is the basic
information needed to plan your own tournament:

On the weekend of September 29th, VEKN players and Princes will team up
with retailers around the world to organize a launch event for White
Wolf's award winning CCG, Vampire: The Eternal Struggle. Coinciding with
the launch of Lords of the Night, this event will celebrate the latest
expansion of one of the longest running CCGs in the market.

Retailers:

VTES Lords of the Night Launch Kit:
Stock #: WWP2766ISBN#: 158846-341-9
Retail Price: $249.99 US
Contents: 2 booster displays of VTES Lords of the Night, 2 starter
displays of VTES Lords of the Night, and 16 Argent Baton promo.

Princes/Organizers:

There is enough material to run a sealed starter event for 16 players.

Please follow the standard rules for a Sealed Deck Limited Event:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules#sec7.3

7.3. Standard Sealed Deck Tournament Rules

7.3.1. Deck Construction

Before tournament play begins, each player receives an assortment of
sealed product. Each player then creates a tournament deck that meets
the Sealed-Deck size requirements found in the game's VEKN Floor Rules.
Players are given a set amount of time, determined by the event
organizer, in which to construct their decks.

The head judge or tournament organizer may require players to record on
a decklist every card they intend to play in their decks. Failure to
properly record the cards being played will result in the head judge
applying the appropriate provisions of the VEKN Penalty Guidelines.

AFTER THE EVENT: Let us know how things went. The WW Website will be
putting up a news story on the launch events. We want pictures. Tell us
how many people showed up. How many players did you meet? We'll draw a
name from the post-event reports submitted and send one person a display
of Lords of the Night, just to say thanks for keeping us in the loop.

PRICES MAY VARY FOR INDIVIDUAL RETAILERS. Princes, organizers, or
retailers with concerns may contact Oscar Garza, the Organized Play
Coordinator at org...@white-wolf.com

Vampire: The Eternal Struggle celebrates its thirteenth anniversary this
year. Designed by Richard Garfield, designer of Magic: The Gathering®,
VTES allows players to pit clans of vampires against one another in a
mix of intrigue and action.

About White Wolf
Since its entry into the role-playing game market in 1991, White Wolf
has maintained an impressive market share. With collective book sales in
excess of 5.5 million copies, White Wolf is one of the undisputed
leaders worldwide for publishing pen-and-paper role-playing games.
Company properties have been licensed for television series, comic
books, action figures, console and computer video games, coin-operated
arcade games, professional wrestlers, replica props and weapons,
interactive media events and myriad merchandise. In November 2006, White
Wolf merged with CCP hf to form CCP North America | White Wolf. More
information on White Wolf can be found at www.white-wolf.com.

Play VTES Online at http://www.vtesonline.com

Regards
DaveZ

Isn't VTES currently in its 14th year of play, not its 13th? Or is
meant to imply that the game's "birthday" in 1994 has not yet rolled
around this year?

> On the weekend of September 29th, VEKN players and Princes will team up
> with retailers around the world to organize a launch event for White
> Wolf's award winning CCG, Vampire: The Eternal Struggle. Coinciding with
> the launch of Lords of the Night, this event will celebrate the latest

So the expansion comes out on the 26th, and the launch events are
supposed to begin on the 29th? Will there not be a weekend of
prerelease events as with previous expansions?

> VTES Lords of the Night Launch Kit:
> Stock #: WWP2766ISBN#: 158846-341-9
> Retail Price: $249.99 US
> Contents: 2 booster displays of VTES Lords of the Night, 2 starter
> displays of VTES Lords of the Night, and 16 Argent Baton promo.

Aside from the 16 Argent Batons, which are worthless, is there any
particular incentive for retailers to order this kit instead of
ordering individual boxes? Will these arrive earlier or something?

> Please follow the standard rules for a Sealed Deck Limited >Event:http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules#sec7.3

Why is this considered preferable to using a sealed started and
drafting boosters, which is what most playgroups seem to do with new
sets? Is it so the events can be sanctioned? For that matter, why
hasn't VEKN sanctioned a sealed deck + drafted boosters format? Would
anyone at White Wolf or VEKN object if individual groups decided to
draft their boosters rather than simply opening them prior to deck
construction?

1996- 1997 is the third
1997-1998 - 4th
1998 -1999- 5th
1999-2000 - 6th
2000-2001 - 7th
